• 2026-09-01 14:30–15:00 PDT
• 2026-09-01 16:00–16:30 PDT

If neither fits, reply with 2–3 times that do and we’ll slot you in.

If you'd prefer, Diego on ops is on this thread and can step in to schedule and handle any priority requests.

Best,
